title: 少一些選擇，做大一個循環

lines.text: 一九八三年，Sinegal 和 Jeff Brotman 共同創立 Costco，

data.prompt: Wide shot inside a spacious warehouse store, one generic customer pauses beside shelves holding a few kinds of plain bulk packages, curious expression, soft skylight

lines.text: 第一間倉儲店在西雅圖開門。
這種賣場有個看起來矛盾的選擇：

data.prompt: Medium shot at a well-stocked warehouse shelf, one generic buyer selects one plain package from a neat repeating row, focused face, mild overhead light

lines.text: 空間很大，商品卻不是越多越好。少一些品項，到底少掉了什麼？

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a buying desk, one generic planner spreads several differently sized plain sample boxes across a small tray, puzzled expression, soft window light

lines.text: 先拿同一種日用品來想像。如果採購的力氣分散到很多尺寸和款式，

data.prompt: Close-up at the same buying desk, one generic planner lifts a small stack of plain packages from one of several separate trays, thoughtful face, mild lamp light

lines.text: 每款只買一點，集中買一大批的優勢就會變小。

data.prompt: Medium shot in a warehouse receiving area, one generic buyer checks a large pallet of matching plain packages, attentive face, diffuse doorway light

lines.text: Costco 在年報裡解釋，有限品項配上低價，是為了形成大銷量，

data.prompt: Wide shot along a warehouse corridor, one generic employee steers a loaded trolley toward the store floor, focused expression, soft ceiling light

lines.text: 讓貨品更快流動。大量採購和有效率的配送，再替這個循環省下成本。

data.prompt: Medium shot beside a warehouse shelf, one generic stocker slides a plain carton into a newly cleared shelf space, purposeful face, mild overhead light

lines.text: 所以，低價不能只是一張海報。貨進得來，架上周轉得動，

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a checkout lane, one generic customer places a bulk package on the counter, relaxed expression, an unmarked price stand beside it, soft store light

lines.text: 前面少收的那一點，才有機會靠整套做法承受。

data.prompt: Wide shot at a warehouse receiving dock in 1993, one generic receiver guides a pallet toward a bay containing two groups of plain cartons, focused face, overcast light

lines.text: 一九九三年，Costco 和 Price Club 合併。
官方沿革記載，合併後共有兩百零六個據點，年銷售額一百六十億美元。

data.prompt: Wide shot inside a larger warehouse distribution hall, one generic dispatcher opens a plain loading gate beside organized carton rows, attentive face, soft grey daylight

lines.text: 當年那個飛機棚，接上了更大的採購與銷售網路。

data.prompt: Medium shot in a warehouse aisle, one generic member places a bulk household package into a trolley, pleased expression, diffuse overhead light

lines.text: 故事到這裡，已經能看出倉儲賣場為什麼敢把價格壓低。

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a food counter, one generic clerk sets a hot dog tray beside a plain price stand, thoughtful expression, mild ceiling light

lines.text: 可是，熱狗又多了一個限制：商品可以換、採購可以談，

data.prompt: Close-up at the same food counter, one generic worker wipes the base of a blank price stand beside the hot dog tray, concerned face partly visible, soft window light

lines.text: 這份套餐的售價卻一直被留在原地。
當成本往上走，要守住它，

data.prompt: Wide shot behind a warehouse food counter, one generic worker opens a plain ingredient cupboard, focused face, preparation equipment visible beside it, neutral overhead light

lines.text: 就不能只要求櫃台上的價牌別動。真正要動手的地方，在櫃台後面。
